body.id: Ringkasan dan seluruh rincian kegiatan kini dipertahankan bersama selama muat dalam kapasitas yang tersedia.
body.en: Activity summaries and all details are now preserved together when they fit within the available capacity.

items.id: Kiriman yang terlalu panjang kini diberi pemberitahuan, bukan dipotong tanpa diketahui.
items.en: Overlong submissions now receive a clear notice instead of being silently cut off.
